title: Cells in a Range on an Excel Sheet
summary: Given a cell range in the format :, where represents the column c1, represents the row r1, represents the column c2, and represents the row r2, return a list of cells (x, y) such that r1 and should be sorted in non-decreasing order first by columns and then by rows.
statement: Given a cell range in the format :, where represents the column c1, represents the row r1, represents the column c2, and represents the row r2, return a list of cells (x, y) such that r1 and should be sorted in non-decreasing order first by columns and then by rows.
constraints: s has form C1:C2 with uppercase columns A through Z and single-digit rows 1 through 9.
The first cell is no later than the second in both column and row.
Return cells ordered by column first, then row within each column.
hints: The required order is a nested column-major enumeration.
Convert column letters to character codes and row digits to integers, using inclusive endpoints.
Loop columns from start through end; inside, loop rows from start through end and format each cell.
The nested loop order matches the specified sort and visits every Cartesian-product cell exactly once.
editorial: The nested loop order matches the specified sort and visits every Cartesian-product cell exactly once.

tests.explanation: Columns K then L each contribute rows 1 then 2, giving [K1,K2,L1,L2].
One column across rows one through three gives [A1,A2,A3].
